Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
I know somebody has writen about this before, but I couldn't find it.

Spontaneous Power
Type: Master
Cost: 2 pool
Unique master.
Put this card on a vampire and choose a Discipline. This vampire gains
1 level of the chosen Discipline. While in play, this card counts as a
master: Discipline card.

If Ian gets this, will he gain superior discipline 'cos SP counts as a
master: discipline card?
